prompt:
This is a panoramic dental X-ray.
Use ONLY the Universal Numbering System: teeth are numbered 1-32.
- Teeth 1-16: upper jaw (patient's right to left)
- Teeth 17-32: lower jaw (patient's left to right)
Do NOT use FDI numbers (11-48).

Identify which teeth are missing (gaps or empty sockets).
The Total missing line is formatting only and is not used for scoring.

Answer in exactly this format and nothing else:
Missing teeth: <comma-separated Universal numbers 1-32, or None>
Total missing: <count>
Confidence: High/Medium/Low

run_config.n_cases_note: Paper evaluation is all usable Tufts cases (1000). The Aug 2026 100-case JSONs are archive only.
run_config.parse_source: Missing teeth line only; Total missing ignored
run_config.bootstrap_note: Independent sampling unit is the patient. All radiographs from the same patient are kept together in each replicate. On Tufts and DENTEX QED each image ID is unique and no multi-image patient identifier exists, so patient = image.
run_config.few_shot_examples: synthetic text templates, not Tufts case IDs
